review: Atomic mkdir lock shared by capture and complete persist read-modify-write; acquired before digest lookup and held through save and parent fsync.
Normal errors and existing-record idempotent return execute finally release. Capture release is idempotent; identity replacement rejects release and preserves fail-closed state.
Crashed lock holder leaves directory; no stale-timeout stealing. Updated cooperating writers reject lock contention.
Existing capture wrapper tests cover callback error and partial acquisition release; new child tests cover competing capture/writer, crash and 60 retained records across 3 writers.
packaging_note: Untracked old request-owner-shared-lock.test.ts remains alongside renamed work8-request-owner-shared-lock.test.ts. Integrate only the three exact reviewed paths; omit untracked duplicate and node_modules.
limits: No full recovery acceptance; only request-owner shared lock boundary.
Older binaries and raw filesystem writers are not fenced.
No Redis, full application restore or protected custody claim.
Crash lock recovery requires separately authorized quiescent intervention; liveness after crash is intentionally not automatic.
